evals.name: Profile a bloated 750-line CLAUDE.md and split reference tables into references/
evals.prompt: Our root `CLAUDE.md` has grown to 750 lines with SQL migration templates and API error catalogs, burning tokens on every prompt. Profile our context budget and refactor it using progressive disclosure.

assertions.description: Agent executed the deterministic context budget profiler script.
Heavy reference material was extracted into on-demand references/*.md files.

evals.name: Reduce startup token tax from alwaysApply Cursor rules
evals.prompt: Audit why Cursor and Claude Code load over 6,000 instruction tokens on startup in this repo and optimize `.cursor/rules/` and `AGENTS.md`.

assertions.description: Agent measured always-on vs L1 token load with profile_context_budget.py.
Agent converted unneeded always-on rules to glob-scoped or on-demand references.

evals.name: Trim an oversized SKILL.md manifest to satisfy progressive disclosure budgets
evals.prompt: Review `.claude/skills/internal-deploy/SKILL.md` (620 lines, 3,100 words) so it satisfies progressive disclosure limits without losing deployment runbook details.

assertions.description: Agent ran profile_context_budget.py before and after splitting.
Detailed runbook sections were offloaded to references/ while keeping SKILL.md concise.
